benefits.text:
Contains exclusive Kingsberry Vita™ and vitamin-rich Vita Beads. Smooth cream texture that absorbs easily. Creates a “Berry Glass Skin” effect. Clinically tested.
The product provides deep moisture and restores the skin's protective barrier with antioxidant-rich Kingsberry Vita™ extract. The Vita Beads melt when applied, delivering vitamins directly, helping improve skin pigmentation and increase elasticity. After each night, skin becomes smooth, dewy and radiant as if reborn.

howToUse.text:
Using the hince Gua Sha massage spoon: After applying the cream by hand, gently massage with the Gua Sha to help the skin absorb it better and achieve a natural dewy look.
By hand: While applying the cream, gently break the Vita Beads with your hands to help the nutrients absorb more deeply and effectively into the skin.

safety.text:
For external use only; avoid direct contact with eyes.
Do not use on damaged skin and discontinue use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: A night cream that helps skin become moist, smooth, more radiant and dewier with the Kingsberry Vita™ formula and Vita Beads.

sellingPoints.text: Contains exclusive Kingsberry Vita™; vitamin-rich Vita Beads that melt when applied; creates a Berry Glass Skin effect after the night routine.

texture.text: Smooth cream with Vita Beads, absorbs easily when massaged.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not use claims of treating, healing or restoring skin in a medical sense. Claims about improving pigmentation/elasticity/dewiness must be accompanied by the context “according to the brand's materials/testing”, without promising the same results for every skin type.
